script_text: Aries, Mars—your ruling Fire planet—ignites a dramatic love-money showdown this week. Monday to Wednesday, Mars in your 5th House trines Jupiter, making Tuesday ideal for big new romance and creative bets. But Mercury in Libra squares your 7th House Wednesday, so skip partnership talks or signing contracts until Thursday. Thursday is the turning point: the Sun enters your 8th House, shifting energy from passion to shared finances and intimacy. Friday through Sunday, Venus sextile Saturn in your 12th House supports relationship healing and secret financial planning. The weekend really rewards privacy, travel research, and spiritual bonding. Best day: Thursday, because Mars trines Jupiter in your 9th House of adventure, luck, and higher learning. Worst day: Wednesday, because Mercury squares your 7th House, sparking relationship conflict. Weekly advice: Check your bank account before making grand romantic gestures. Follow for daily updates.
